witnesses: Please tell me what you know about the safety incident that took place in as much detail as you can.
How were you made aware of the incident?
If you were present, were you injured?
How and why do you believe this happened?
What was happening in the location of the incident at the time it occurred?
Do you know if the incident was due to the failure of equipment or tools?
Do you know of any evidence that could help us determine if this was caused by unsafe conditions that exist or if a procedure or safety rule was not followed or was not sufficient?
Do you know if personal protective equipment (PPE) was required for the work being performed at the time of the incident?
If required, do you know if everyone involved was wearing the proper PPE?
At the time of the incident, were you aware of any other person acting in a way that may have contributed to the safety incident?
Do you have any suggestions on how this incident could have been prevented?
Is there anyone else who you believe should be interviewed that may have additional information pertaining to this investigation?
Have you heard discussions in the workplace regarding the incident? If so, when and by whom?
Is there any other information you would like to provide?
